newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 21 and 23 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on July 3, the Treasury said on Tuesday.

The Treasury will offer a new 10-year benchmark OAT, a 5.50 percent October 25, 2007 OAT, and the 2009 TEC 10 variable rate OAT, which was expected to make up two to four billion francs of the total amount sold.
Both bonds will have a payment date of July 10, the statement said.
The announcement means no Ecu OATs will be sold in July.

Starting in July, French Ecu-denominated government bonds will be sold at the same time as French franc OATs or BTANs. Previously they were sold at a separate regular monthly auction on the second Thursday of the month.
